description: This Perl script appears to be a utility for manipulating chunk files, including reading, copying, and adjusting offsets within binary file formats. It handles reading data from standard input and output, with specific functions for dealing with 64-bit file offsets, and includes logic for processing table-of-contents entries within chunked files.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from STDIN, with error checking.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Reads bytes from STDIN and prints them to STDOUT, effectively copying data.

methods.name: unpack_quad
methods.description: Unpacks 8 bytes as two 32-bit unsigned integers and returns the second, simulating a 64-bit offset.

methods.name: pack_quad
methods.description: Packs a 32-bit integer into two 32-bit parts with leading zero, forming a 64-bit value, and verifies the round-trip.
